name: GNU bash 'Shellshock'
defect: Importing a function from an environment-style string evaluated trailing code after the function definition. The vulnerable release is the pristine upstream bash-4.3.0; the fixed release is bash-4.3.30 (the last 4.3 patch release, carrying the CVE-2014-6271/7169 fixes).

clean_control.expectation: no residual on any axis (without the malicious environment import, the vulnerable and fixed builds are byte-identical on stdout and exit)
